isDragging.description: Whether a drag is in progress.

isKeyboardDragging.description: Whether a keyboard drag session is active.

dragSource.description: The value of the item being dragged (the one the user grabbed).

dragValues.description: All values being dragged. Includes selected items when multi-item drag is active.

dropTarget.description: The value of the current drop target.

dropPlacement.description: The current drop placement relative to the target.

getItemState.description: Get the drag/drop state for a specific item.

pointerPosition.description: The current pointer position during drag. Null when not dragging.

instructions.description:
Keyboard instructions text for screen readers.
Automatically set as `aria-description` on draggable and drag handle elements.

getDragPreviewState.description: Returns the state of the drag preview

edgeThreshold.description: Pixel threshold from edges for before/after detection when "drop on" is valid.

stickyDelay.description:
Milliseconds to keep a drop target active after the pointer leaves
(prevents flicker on gaps between items).

dragOverDelay.description:
Debounce delay in milliseconds for live region announcements and onDragOver callbacks
during pointer drag. Prevents overwhelming screen readers and excessive callback invocations.

scrollThreshold.description:
Pixel margin from the scrollable container edges that triggers auto-scrolling.
Set to 0 to disable auto-scroll.

scrollMaxSpeed.description: Maximum auto-scroll speed in pixels per animation frame.

columnCount.description:
Number of columns in a grid layout. When set, enables grid-mode collision
detection and 4-directional keyboard navigation.

selectedValues.description:
The values of items currently selected. When the user drags one of the
selected items, all selected items are included in the drag operation.

activationConstraint.type: { distance?: number | undefined; delay?: number | undefined } | undefined
activationConstraint.description: Activation constraint for pointer drag. Prevents accidental drags.

canDrag.description: Whether the given item value can be dragged.

canDrop.type: ((source: string, target: string, placement: DropPlacement) => boolean) | undefined
canDrop.description:
Whether a drop is allowed at the given target and placement.
Use this to prevent dropping on self, descendants, etc.

getValueText.description:
Resolve a human-readable label for a value. Used for live region announcements.
If not provided, falls back to the element's textContent.

onDragOver.description: Called when the drag moves over a new target.

onDrop.description: Called when the item is dropped on a valid target.

onDragEnd.description: Called when the drag ends (either by dropping or cancelling).

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the dnd. Useful for composition.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Root.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state

Draggable.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state

DragPreview.data-dragging: Present when in the dragging state
